name: Interfaces for editors: viewport renderers, select, hover end
body:
# Interfaces for editors

The backend-agnostic contracts Lantern's world editor needs between Chaos and a rendering backend: a viewport
renderer a host registers by name (Dean's answer on `GAME-F02-T05`), and the prop-diff fields for `<select>`, hover
end and key-up. This package stays dependency-free.
